title: Studio on zh-CN still mixes languages and terms: view properties panel, flow nodes, publish sheet labels, and 仪表板 beside 仪表盘
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「缺陷 2-7 立卡」 (2026-11-04).

Filed by the record-page epic seat from a browser evaluation of the Console on `main` `63b86b385d` (example CRM, zh-CN, dev admin). An independent reviewer ran the pass and the seat re-checked the evidence named below. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

Every list-view edit, new flow and publish review on a Chinese console passes through English developer text. The publish sheet matters most: it is where an admin checks what is about to go live, and it says `~ Status` and `dataset`. The same object is also called both 仪表板 and 仪表盘 within one flow of work. #29773 and #29841 closed other parts of this family; this card closes the positions below.

## Positions

| Where | What the reader sees | Evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| View properties panel, below 条件格式化 (`/studio/com.example.crm/interfaces?surface=view:crm_lead.all`, 属性) | Basics, Identity and primary surface., View description for documentation/tooltips, Columns & filters, Add filter, Searchable Fields, Table options, End-user controls, Navigation & sharing | Seat read these in the page text |
| Publish sheet, a flow's detail | 其他变更： `~ Status` | Seat saw it in the browser |
| Publish sheet, summary line | 5 项 · 对象 1 · 流程 1 · 仪表盘 1 · dataset 1 · 权限集 1 | Seat read the screenshot |
| Flow 问题 tab, a flow whose trigger is not armed here | 未在此运行, then "no 'record_change' trigger is registered — add requires: ['triggers'] …" in English, above 没有问题 —— 该流程结构有效 | Seat saw it in the browser |
| Flow palette and notify node | "Save notice" and its description; the notify node's "Template" and its description | Reviewer's report; the seat read both strings in source |
| Terms | 仪表板 in the rail and menu, 仪表盘 in the create dialog and publish sheet | Seat read both on screenshots |

## Code readings on `63b86b385d`

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts:99-102`: the zh-CN overlay's `metadataForms` names `dashboard`. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts:24-25` holds the English the view panel shows, and the file's own note says a type the bundle does not name is returned untouched. Which other types are missing is part of this card.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts:87` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/changeKeyLabels.ts`: the publish sheet's labels read this overlay.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/save-notice-node.ts:41-43` and `notify-node.ts:825`: the English comes from the server's descriptors.
- Term counts: `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` has 仪表盘 on 15 lines and 仪表板 on 2; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` has 18 and 16. The overlay above uses 仪表板.

## Acceptance

1. Each position above reads in zh-CN, on a console set to zh-CN. English stays as the source text for an English console.
2. The overlay is enumerated against every form type Studio renders, and the PR lists what was added. A type left out is named with its reason.
3. The not-running message says in plain words that this deployment does not run this kind of trigger and who can change that, and it no longer sits above a line saying there are no problems.
4. One word for dashboard across zh-CN Console and Studio text: 仪表盘, the more common of the two in these files, unless the maintainer says otherwise on this card.
5. Browser checks at the positions above, with screenshots on the PR.

## Not in this card

Other locales (the designer's carve-out is `en` + `zh`), and adding a new i18n gate.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "label: 'Basics'" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`
